candidate.basis: SPEC-04 §6 Recovery Seal State Transition Table: a valid 0x0c spend of recovery_seal moves the origin to pending_recovery (RECOVERY_FORBIDDEN); once h_rec + delay_blocks passes without a valid 0x10 cancel, B_{k+1} is active and B_k is superseded (ORIGIN_BINDING_INVALID); only a malformed spend or a recovery_seal 'absent from UTXO without valid 0x0c record' burns the recovery line and lets B_k continue. The 0x0c record here is the one the paired control verifies; whether it is valid is a property of the chain, and CONFORMANCE.md §2 item 5 says a verifier 'MUST NOT accept ledger state, block heights, or UTXO spend status from the presenter or issuer'. Withholding the candidate document therefore cannot turn the recovery into a burned one: the expected result is the paired control's.

findings.title: Path A: a round trip of the ward name through another key before T makes the origin autonomous at T, while the name is held by the guardians' owner_policy again
A mismatched majority opening: the text requires ORIGIN_STATUS_INCOMPLETE, the published vector and the reference return ORIGIN_UNVERIFIED
Station target authority is default-open: on a host without configuration any root issuer may grant agent/tool on station:<host>:<slot>

A required profile quota that counts another resource is accepted: the registry and profiles say resource = target, the reference compares only kind and unit, and the published trace-03 relies on that
Bearer Sessions: seallink-session-open/1 is admitted on a backing grant that the §4 pipeline refuses (forged and never anchored, or issued by a stranger over another owner's mailbox)
Credential subject.mode = "origin" is verified only when the presenter volunteers an origin bundle

MachineClauseTerms has two definitions (also N-1): the prose has a clause member machine {capabilities?, config_sha256?, window?}, the schema and the reference machine_terms {capabilities, not_before_height?, not_after_height?}, so the bytes of a committed clause are undefined

refusal_code_status_semantics.derived: No rule names a code for this exact condition, but the text makes the result equal to that of a paired control: the varied element cannot change the subject's state (a presenter-supplied or presenter-withheld element, while the state is defined by chain events), or the same admission pipeline runs on the same grant. The expected result is therefore the paired control's. Where failing closed on the element itself is equally defensible, that result is listed in also_acceptable.
refusal_code_status_semantics.text: The refusal code is named by the cited rule or by its registry description for exactly this condition.
refusal_code_status_semantics.undefined: draft.7 defines no admission step or refusal code for this condition: expected_refusal is null, only the verdict is compared, and candidate.proposed_refusal is informative.

role_semantics.control: Passes on the reference and must keep passing.
role_semantics.decision: Text and published vectors (or two readings) differ; expected_* mirrors readings[0]. Needs an authors' decision.
role_semantics.witness: expected_* follows the cited specification text; reference_result is what the reference returns today.
